english.note: Use this when “compromised” means exposed to discredit or damage to one’s reputation.

examples.english: After the scandal broke, his reputation was compromised, and even his friends distanced themselves from him.
examples.traditional: 件醜聞一出，佢嘅名聲受損，連朋友都疏遠佢。
